description: The pie chart, titled "Stimuli Type," displays the distribution of different types of stimuli used in developing story case studies of generative AI's use in journalism. The chart is divided into eight distinct segments, each representing a different stimulus type with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is "Press Release," accounting for 21.9% of the total. This is followed by "External News Article" at 13.1%, "Interview" at 10.2%, and "Organizational Report" and "Event Posting," both at 8.8%. "Organizational Website" makes up 6.6% of the stimuli, while "Social Media Post" accounts for 1.5%. The smallest segment is "Intra-agency news article," which represents only 0.7% of the total. The segments are arranged in a circular fashion around the central title, with each category clearly labeled and its percentage value indicated. The chart uses a variety of colors to differentiate between the categories, with the largest segment, "Press Release," being a dark red color. The other segments are colored in shades of yellow, green, blue, purple, and gray, providing a clear visual distinction between the different types of stimuli.
